facts.business: India Lease Development Limited is a non-banking finance company engaged in leasing and financing activities, currently consolidating its position and focusing on recovery from existing clients.

auditor.name: M/s Jagdish Chand & Co. Chartered Accountants

key_risks: No fresh business exposure leading to reliance on existing clients who may default
Non-compliance with RBI principal business criteria (financial assets less than 50% of total assets)
Volatile market conditions affecting deployment in financing activities
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are disclosed in Note 30 of the financial statements; these transactions are not likely to have any conflict with the Company's interest. Directors with potential interest do not participate in discussions or voting on such matters.
